name: securevision
description: SecureVision monorepo — ML microservice + Node gateway + React SPA

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "ML,API,UI" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,magenta" "npm run dev:ml" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: cd server && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build
scripts.lint: cd server && npm run lint && cd ../client && npm run lint
